missing_methods.intent: Wait for profile name to be visible
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the profile name element in the dashboard header to become visible. This method should implement an explicit wait with a configurable timeout (default 10 seconds) to ensure the profile name element is displayed before proceeding. Should return True if visible within timeout, False otherwise.
implementation_checklist: Retrieve locator key 'profile_name' from self.locators dictionary
Use self.page.locator() with the retrieved locator to find the profile name element
Call wait_for() method on the element with state='visible' and timeout parameter (converted to milliseconds: timeout*1000)
Wrap the wait_for() call in try-except block to catch TimeoutError
Return True if element becomes visible within timeout
Return False if TimeoutError is caught
